sourceSentences: Zac stretches his left arm in the target direction that catches the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage, slowing them by 40% for 0.5 seconds, and forming a tether between Zac and the target for 2 seconds.
While the tether persists, Zac's next basic attack is replaced by a second Stretching Strike.
If the two targets are within 700 units of each other, they are instead slammed together through the displacement. Upon impact of each other, both targets are knocked up and stunned for 0.25 seconds.
Non-champion units that are affected by Stretching Strikes displacement are prevented from taking any damage until they are slammed together.
this often confuses players who are trying to secure monsters via Smite while Zac is slamming the wanted target, resulting in Smite dealing no damage to it.
Unstable Matter's current cooldown is reduced by 1 second whenever Zac collects a Cell Division chunk.
If Zac cancels the channel himself, or the charge completes without reactivation, 50% of Elastic Slingshot's health cost and cooldown are refunded.
knocks them up and stuns them for 0.5 seconds, increased to 1 second if Elastic Slingshot was charged for more than 1 second.
target range: 1200 to 1800 [Maximum dash distance]
Let's Bounce! initiates the recast and is buffered to cast itself at the end of the dash.
Elastic Slingshot channel table: Flash disabled; interrupts = silence, death, root, ground.

Zac can move while Let's Bounce! is active, gaining ghosting and movement speed, but becomes unable to declare basic attacks, Stretching Strikes, and Elastic Slingshot. He also automatically consumes all Cell Division within the bounce radius.
Let's Bounce! interaction table: Q and E are disabled. W is usable. Summoner spells (Flash included) usable.
Contestable: They will fall to the ground at a point which is roughly equidistant from Zac and the nearest visible enemy champion within 1000 range of him.
Any damage the bloblets receive is also echoed to Zac as true damage. After the duration, Zac is revived with 10 – 50% maximum health based on his bloblets' total remaining health.
